title.narrative: OCHA Pooled Fund Management Branch (PFMB) - (SDC Funded)

description.narrative: UNOPS supports the UN OCHA Pooled Fund Management Branch (PFMB) to deliver on the objectives of the OCHA 2023-2026 Strategic Plan, primarily on the priority 5 that focuses on catalytic humanitarian financing that delivers impact in people’s lives, as well as to contribute to the implementation of the OCHA Communications Strategy 2024-2026 and the Partnership and Resource Mobilization Strategy 2023-2026, through specialized expertise and technical support services that can be scaled up and down in line with the humanitarian programme cycles.
